title: SugarTrack – an offline Android logbook for blood sugar (no account, no cloud)
summary: SugarTrack is a privacy-focused Android app for logging blood sugar levels that works completely offline without requiring user accounts or cloud storage. The app targets diabetic patients who need a simple, secure way to track their glucose readings without data privacy concerns.
problem_solved: Provides a private, offline-first blood sugar tracking solution for diabetics who want to avoid cloud accounts and data sharing
why_valuable: Respects user privacy by eliminating account requirements and cloud dependencies while providing essential diabetes management functionality
